title: Design System: Golf Trip Live Scorecard

display.purpose: Landing hero h1 only. Fraunces 600, fluid clamp.

headline.purpose: Section h2 on brand surfaces. Fraunces 500.

title.purpose: In-app page titles (My Trips, Trip Hub). Fraunces.

body.purpose: Body copy and descriptions. Manrope, capped 65-75ch.

eyebrow.purpose: Section micro-labels. UPPERCASE Manrope 700, 0.32em tracking, brass.

shadows.name: subtle
shadows.purpose: Resting lift on a forest-context element that genuinely needs separation.

shadows.name: brass-cta
shadows.purpose: The one expressive drop in the system, reserved for the primary brass pill.

motion.name: society-rise
motion.purpose: The only arrival animation: opacity 0 + translateY(8px) to settled. Staggered via animationDelay. Skips to end under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: live-ping
motion.purpose: The live-dot pulse overlay. Reduces to a static dot under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: cta-lift
motion.purpose: Hover lift on the primary CTA, -translate-y-0.5. Transform only, no color flash.

components.name: Primary Button (Brass Pill)
components.description: The system's one primary action. One per screen, identical on landing and in-app empty states.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: hsl(42 52% 59%); color: hsl(38 30% 14%); font-family: 'Manrope', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; padding: 14px 28px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 hsl(42 60% 48%) inset, 0 14px 30px -12px hsla(42,60%,50%,0.55), 0 2px 0 hsla(0,0%,0%,0.18); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(42 60% 48%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Default Button (Shadcn)
components.description: In-app secondary action. Brass fill with a tinted border, square-ish 10px radius.
components.css: .ds-btn-default { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; background: hsl(42 52% 59%); color: hsl(38 30% 12%); border: 1px solid hsl(42 52% 51%); border-radius: 10px; font-family: 'Manrope', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-default::after { content: ''; } .ds-btn-default:hover { background: hsl(42 52% 56%); } .ds-btn-default:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px hsl(42 60% 60%); }

components.name: Eyebrow
components.description: Section-introducing micro-label above an h2. Brass on forest, Brass Ink on cream.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { display: inline-block; font-family: 'Manrope', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.32em; text-transform: uppercase; color: hsl(42 52% 59%); }

components.name: Live Indicator
components.description: A pulsing brass-green dot signalling silent auto-refresh. The pulse is the entire signal.
components.css: .ds-live { position: relative; display: inline-flex; height: 6px; width: 6px; } .ds-live-ping { position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: hsl(148 45% 40%); opacity: 0.75; animation: ds-ping 1.6s cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1) infinite; } .ds-live-dot { position: relative; display: inline-flex; height: 6px; width: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: hsl(148 45% 40%); } @keyframes ds-ping { 75%, 100% { transform: scale(2.4); opacity: 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-live-ping { animation: none; opacity: 0; } }

components.name: Score Cell Row
components.description: A run of score cells from the 18-hole grid. Color plus number, never color alone. Each cell is a 44x44 touch target.
components.html: 23456
components.css: .ds-score-row { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; font-family: 'Manrope', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-cell { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 15px; } .ds-eagle { background: hsl(42 60% 55%); color: hsl(38 30% 12%); } .ds-birdie { background: hsl(148 45% 40%); color: hsl(42 45% 91%); } .ds-par { background: hsl(42 20% 84%); color: hsl(38 30% 18%); } .ds-bogey { background: hsl(30 40% 75%); color: hsl(38 30% 18%); } .ds-double { background: hsl(0 45% 45%); color: hsl(42 45% 91%); } .ds-empty { background: hsl(42 25% 78%); }

components.name: Scorecard Card
components.description: The signature surface: cream card on forest with a paper-band header strip, dashed divider, and a brass corner stamp. Start every score-shaped display from this.
components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; max-width: 320px; background: hsl(42 45% 91%); color: hsl(38 30% 14%); border: 1px solid hsl(38 25% 78%); border-radius: 14px; padding: 20px; font-family: 'Manrope', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-stamp { position: absolute; top: -12px; right: -12px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 34px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 9999px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, hsl(42 52% 59%) 0%, hsl(42 60% 48%) 70%); color: hsl(38 30% 12%); font-weight: 700; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-card-band { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 6px 0; border-bottom: 1px dashed hsl(38 25% 78%); font-weight: 700; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: hsl(38 20% 38%); } .ds-card-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding-top: 12px; } .ds-card-name { font-family: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 17px; } .ds-card-total { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; color: hsl(148 45% 40%); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Cream-tinted field with a brass focus ring. 16px font on phone widths to prevent iOS auto-zoom.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; background: hsl(42 45% 93%); color: hsl(38 30% 14%); border: 1px solid hsl(38 25% 72%); border-radius: 10px; font-family: 'Manrope', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: hsl(38 20% 50%); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: hsl(42 60% 60%); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px hsl(42 60% 60%); }

narrative.overview: The whole system points at one object: a cream paper scorecard a club steward hands you across the counter, brass clip still warm, dashed dividers printed crisp, every number set in tabular figures. Not a 1920s parody, not country-club costume. A working instrument that happens to be beautiful. The structural law underneath is dark shell, light surface: a forest-green app frame holds cream card surfaces where the actual scoring happens. The shell carries the brand; the cards carry the work. Brass is the seam, the stamp and the clip, used at roughly 10% and never decoratively. Color strategy is Committed: forest and cream each carry 30 to 60% of any screen, and the identity lives in that contrast, not in a lone accent. It rejects the PGA-Tour-broadcast aesthetic above all: flatter, quieter, more printed-paper than rendered-pixel.
keyCharacteristics: Two-surface architecture: forest shell, cream cards, brass seam.
Printed-paper voice: dashed dividers, dotted-leader rows, UPPERCASE letter-spaced chrome, tabular numerals everywhere a number lives.
Mobile-first, single-thumb, sun-legible. The shell caps at 512px on every viewport.
Live without alarming: silent refresh, a single pulsing brass-green dot, positions that slide rather than flash.
Heritage as material, not theme: it should feel handed to you, not rendered for you.

rules.name: The Two-Surface Rule
rules.body: Forest shell, cream card, always. Never invert it (light shell with dark cards). Never collapse it (cream-on-cream, forest-on-forest). A card on top of a card is forbidden. This single contrast is the brand.

rules.name: The Two-Brass Rule
rules.body: Bright Brass (hsl(42 52% 59%)) is forest-context only. On cream, brass steps to Brass Ink (hsl(42 60% 32%)) so labels stay AA-legible. Bright brass text on a cream card is a contrast bug, not a style choice.

rules.name: The Reserved-Brass Rule
rules.body: One brass moment per screen region. Brass is the stamp; brass-on-brass-on-brass dilutes it. If brass is showing up only to add color, remove it.

rules.name: The No-Gray Rule
rules.body: Gray on color is banned. Use cream-on-forest, ink-on-cream, brass-muted-on-forest. Never text-gray-500 on a forest panel.

rules.name: The Serif-Heading Rule
rules.body: All h1/h2/h3 are Fraunces, enforced globally in the base layer. Never override a heading to sans.

rules.name: The Chrome-Caps Rule
rules.body: The printed-scorecard voice is achieved with UPPERCASE Manrope at 8-10px and letter-spacing 0.18-0.32em. A system pattern, not a one-off.

rules.name: The Italic-Brass Rule
rules.body: Serif italic in brass on forest, at section-headline scale only. The one emotional flourish. Never on UI labels or body copy.

rules.name: The No-Gradient-Text Rule
rules.body: background-clip: text over a gradient is forbidden. Brass on forest is already the most expressive treatment; emphasis comes from weight, size, and italic.

rules.name: The Borders-Over-Shadows Rule
rules.body: Reach for a dashed cream border or the paper-band header strip before a shadow. Printed paper has edges, not glows. Only the brass CTA's drop is allowed to be expressive.

rules.name: The Flat-Card Rule
rules.body: Cards sit flat on the forest at rest. The cream-on-forest contrast is the elevation. Stacking shadows on every card reads as web-app, not scorecard.

dos: Do keep the forest shell / cream card / brass seam split on every screen. It is the brand.
Do use tabular numerals on every score, total, and handicap, and align the 18-hole grid to 60px repeat(9, minmax(0,1fr)) 44px.
Do step brass down to Brass Ink (hsl(42 60% 32%)) for any label or eyebrow printed on cream, and verify AA before shipping.
Do pair every score color with a number (and a glyph where space allows) so color is never the only signal.
Do prefer dashed cream borders and the paper-band header strip over drop shadows.
Do let leaderboards refresh silently, signalled only by the single pulsing brass-green dot. Positions slide; they do not flash.
Do keep primary actions in the thumb-reachable bottom two-thirds, touch targets 44x44pt minimum, body inputs 16px minimum on phone.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: the society-rise entry skips to its end state and the live dot reduces to static.
Do address the group, not the user. Title Case for page titles and CTAs, sentence case for body and helper text.
donts: Don't build Tour-broadcast chrome: no 3D leaderboards, beveled position numbers, sponsor-tower lockups, or gradient-fill team colors. The primary anti-reference.
Don't ship the hero-metric template (big number, small label, supporting stats, gradient accent), forbidden even on the landing.
Don't use identical icon-title-text card grids. Vary rhythm deliberately.
Don't reach for casino or sportsbook loudness on the money surfaces: no felt-green textures, neon, or bookie-odds typography.
Don't use the bright-green health-app palette. The only true green is Birdie (hsl(148 45% 40%)), reserved for score cells and the live dot.
Don't use a side-stripe colored border greater than 1px as an accent. It clashes with the cream-paper metaphor.
Don't use gradient text, decorative glassmorphism, em dashes, exclamation points, or emoji.
Don't invert or collapse the two-surface rule, nest a card inside a card, or stack shadows on every card.
Don't add confetti, fireworks, or balloon celebrations on score entry or position changes. Live without alarming.
Don't ship generic shadcn neutral grays. Replace them with the tinted-neutral tokens before merging.
